name: lovetellers
source:
Continental folklore says that the way a cornflower fades can tell you a lot about love. If it fades slowly, your love will last. If it fades quickly, you better not get your hopes up.

Meredith already knows how this story will end: the woman she loves will die. As the flowers keep turning white, she desperately tries to ignore the foreshadowed truth.

[From [url=https://naarel.itch.io/lovetellers]itch.io[/url]]
